View image description and credit by clicking or tapping on the image.

```{python}
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from os import listdir

# Settings
image_width = 600
image_height = 400

# main():
all_images = [f for f in listdir(".") if f.endswith(".webp")]
all_images.sort()

print("::: {layout-ncol=4}\n")
for image in all_images:
  # display(Markdown(f"![]({image}){{width={image_width} height={image_height} style=\"object-fit: cover;\"}}\n\n"))
  display(Markdown(f"![]({image})\n\n"))
print(":::")
```
